method: Rolling-origin model comparison with final holdout
interpretation: Airline ARIMA had the lowest mean validation MAE (1.68); the runner-up was ARIMA(auto) (1.69). Final-holdout MAE for the selection: 1.64. Compare against Seasonal naive before trusting the gain.
assumptions: Regular series with the declared season and no missing periods
The training history's pattern continues over the horizon (no regime change)
Specifications are frozen on the first training slice, so later actuals cannot steer selection
not_done: No regressors, promotions or calendar effects (chapter 13 or 16 add them)
Intervals are the selected model's own plus empirical residual quantiles; no distribution-free guarantee (chapter 17)
evaluation: 5 expanding origins spaced 12 steps apart select the model on mean MAE; the final 12 observations are scored once and never used for selection; the selection is refitted on all history.
intervals: lower/upper are the Airline ARIMA model's nominal 80% intervals; their coverage at the 5 selection origins was 83%. empirical_q* columns add signed residual quantiles by horizon step from those origins (5 residuals per step).
